biotools.summary: markslab-cpvtdb is a database and web application that catalogs clinical data on patients with RYR2-related Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia (CPVT). It maps RYR2 variants to protein structure and allows users to query the database to understand the correlation between variant location and clinical phenotypes.
